purpose: Regenerate three compact V9-only semantic decoration sources after native-200 revision-1 triage. Each source is composed over a V9 component stack that intentionally omits any mutually exclusive inherited charm; no face is generated, replaced or repainted.
composition_contract: Each native 200x200 state is reconstructed from selected locked-V9 Rig components, with the listed mutually exclusive inherited charm not selected; no facial pixel is repainted or covered.
Same-state presence is deterministic: highlight lead, brow answer, mouth/cheek settle, then an optional small decoration beat.
Cross-state bridges use highlight lead, brow answer, lower-face reply and only then the target decoration; no full-face swap, crossfade or random loop.
Exactly one semantic decoration is visible in a decorated emotional hold; the decoration is state context, never the primary emotional signal or a text/UI label.
source_gate: Each source sheet has exactly three separated poses with no face, body, text, label, border, UI panel, grayscale, color or texture.
Every extracted source must retain a minimum 2-pixel black stroke at native 200x200 and remain in its declared safe box without obscuring primary facial masks.
The question, exclamation and dream cloud each read at native 200x200 with labels hidden and no competing inherited charm.
A failed source becomes audit-only and cannot be used as visual input, component export, CRIG binding or firmware asset.
